items.title_zh: 总规模近 3.6GW：谷歌与 Constellation 达成长期电力协议
items.title_en: Google and Constellation Sign 3.59GW Long-Term Power Deal, Including 890MW of New Nuclear
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 6 日消息，Google（谷歌）当地时间今日宣布同美国能源企业 Constellation 达成一份 总规模 3.59GW 的长期战略能源合作 。 这 3.59GW 分为两部分： 890MW 为新增核电容量 ，预计 2028~2032 年上线，持续 20 年； 2.7GW 为任意容量 ，持续 15 年。在谷歌的资金支持下，Constellation 将对其横跨多州的 11 座核电机组进行升级，并在工程建设期间创造约 7,200 个建筑工作岗位。 作为一揽子商业协议的一部分，Constellation 还与谷歌云、Gemini Enterprise 构建为期五年的扩展技术联盟，旨在建立“能源人工智能”蓝图，以加速产能交付、优化资产调度并保护关键基础设施。 谷歌和 Constellation 还达成了一项战略框架协议，旨在评估在美国各地开发新型清洁能源发电、储能和需求响应技术的机会，以支持谷歌的业务增长。 相关阅读： 《 Constellation 收获亚马逊 20 年核电长单，接近与 Alphabet 达成 10 亿美元交易 》
items.summary_en: Google announced a 3.59GW long-term strategic energy partnership with Constellation, comprising 890MW of new nuclear capacity coming online in 2028–2032 over 20 years and 2.7GW of additional capacity over 15 years. Google's funding will support upgrades to 11 nuclear units across multiple states, creating about 7,200 construction jobs. The two also formed a five-year technology alliance with Google Cloud and Gemini Enterprise to build an "energy AI" blueprint, plus a framework agreement to assess new clean power, storage and demand-response opportunities.
items.why_zh: 这是科技巨头为 AI 数据中心锁定大规模无碳电力的标志性交易，也把核电推到 AI 能源供应的核心位置。
items.why_en: It is a landmark deal in which a tech giant locks up large-scale carbon-free power for AI data centers, pushing nuclear to the center of AI energy supply.

items.title_zh: Mistral AI 放出预告：今日新模型可在网安等方面优于中国竞品
items.title_en: Mistral AI Teases New Model, Claiming Edge Over Chinese Rivals in Cybersecurity
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 6 日消息，据路透社报道，法国人工智能初创企业 Mistral AI 首席执行官 Arthur Mensch 当地时间今日在阿拉伯联合酋长国首都阿布扎比举行的 Ai Everything 会议上表示， 该企业将在本日发布新的人工智能模型 。 Arthur Mensch 发言称： 我们今天将要发布的模型 在网络安全等某些方面 ， 实际上都优于中国的模型 。因此，所谓“欧洲无法竞争”的说法是不正确的。 …… 人们对替代性技术供应商有着强烈的渴望和巨大的需求。 这位欧洲最大人工智能“独角兽”企业的掌门人 并未具体说明具体比较对象和网络安全以外的优势领域 。 相关阅读： 《 消息称 Reflection 等多家西方企业本月将推出开放权重 AI 模型 》 《 叫板 DeepSeek、Kimi，英伟达投资的 Reflection AI 发布旗下首款开放权重 AI 模型 Beam 》
items.summary_en: Mistral AI CEO Arthur Mensch said at the Ai Everything conference in Abu Dhabi that the French startup would release a new AI model that day, claiming it outperforms Chinese models in areas such as cybersecurity and arguing that the idea Europe cannot compete is wrong. He said demand for alternative technology suppliers is strong, but did not specify comparison targets or other advantage areas.
items.why_zh: 欧洲头部 AI 公司公开以中国模型为对标，凸显中美欧在开放与主权 AI 市场上的竞争进一步加剧。
items.why_en: A leading European AI firm publicly benchmarking against Chinese models highlights intensifying competition among the US, China and Europe in the open and sovereign AI market.

items.title_zh: 1800 万美元，Anthropic CEO 阿莫迪 2025 年薪酬曝光
items.title_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's 2025 Pay Package Totals $18 Million
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 6 日消息，据路透社报道，Anthropic 的首次公开募股（IPO）招股书显示，公司首席执行官达里奥 · 阿莫迪（Dario Amodei） 去年总薪酬为 1,800 万美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1.21 亿元人民币） 。从薪酬规模来看，他处于主流科技企业高管梯队的中游水平。 阿莫迪的薪酬构成偏向于股票等多元化激励方式，与其他科技企业创始人类似，固定年薪仅占其个人财富总额的很小一部分。 据悉，达里奥 · 阿莫迪与其妹妹 ——Anthropic 总裁丹妮拉 · 阿莫迪（Daniela Amodei）的年薪在今年 7 月翻了一倍，均已达 140 万美元 （现汇率约合 940 万元人民币） 。 股票与股票期权奖励在二人 2025 年的薪酬方案中占据绝大部分，其中丹妮拉 · 阿莫迪去年的薪酬总额达 1,640 万美元 （现汇率约合 1.1 亿元人民币） 。 Anthropic 董事会今年以受限股票单位（RSU）的形式，承诺向兄妹二人追加股权激励。该部分权益约定在达成特定前置条件时方可正式兑现：部分权益与二人的在职期限挂钩，其余部分则与公司的 IPO 进程绑定。 首席财务官克里希纳 · 拉奥 (Krishna Rao) 去年的薪酬总额为 720,250 美元 （现汇率约合 483.6 万元人民币） 。拉奥于 2024 年入职时获授了 140 万股的期权配额，并在…
items.summary_en: Anthropic's IPO filing shows CEO Dario Amodei earned $18 million in total compensation last year, mostly in equity, Reuters reported. President Daniela Amodei received $16.4 million, and both siblings' base salaries doubled to $1.4 million in July. The board granted additional RSUs tied to tenure and the company's IPO process, while CFO Krishna Rao earned $720,250.
items.why_zh: 招股书首度披露 Anthropic 的高管薪酬结构，也侧面印证这家 AI 巨头正推进 IPO 进程。
items.why_en: The filing offers the first look at Anthropic's executive pay structure and signals the AI giant is moving ahead with an IPO.

items.title_zh: 消息称 Meta 和微软要求员工减少使用 Claude，多用自家 AI 节省成本
items.title_en: Meta and Microsoft Tell Staff to Cut Back on Claude and Use In-House AI to Save Costs
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 6 日消息，据 The Information 报道，Meta 与微软已要求员工减少使用 Anthropic 旗下的 AI 模型 Claude 以削减成本，并要求员工更多使用自研 AI 工具。 据悉，微软高层在今年早些时候曾预计，公司内部使用 Anthropic AI 的年支出将至少达到 10 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 67.14 亿元人民币） 。随后，微软要求员工减少对 Claude 的依赖、多使用自研 AI 工具；近期，相关预算已被削减超三分之一。 微软此次调整主要针对内部日常使用，并不代表其对外提供的 Anthropic 模型服务需求同步下滑。目前，该公司仍继续通过企业级云平台向客户提供 Claude 等 AI 模型。 Meta 内部数据则显示，其内部使用 Claude Code 的人数已大幅减少至约 3 万人，而今年早些时候该数字约为 6 万人。除了今年春季裁员约 10% 导致员工总基数缩小外，Meta 近来大力推广自有 AI 工具，也是 Claude 使用量下滑的关键原因。 目前 Meta 已推出多款供员工使用的内部 AI 工具。其中，MetaCode 的内部用户已突破 3 万人；另一款已面向外部客户测试的 Muse Code 已于 8 月上线，目前的内部用户也超过了 6,000 人。Muse Code 搭载了 Meta 自研的大模型，被普遍视…
items.summary_en: The Information reports that Meta and Microsoft are telling employees to rely less on Anthropic's Claude and more on their own AI tools to cut costs. Microsoft's internal Anthropic spending had been projected at $1 billion a year before budgets were cut by more than a third, while Meta's Claude Code users have dropped from about 60,000 to 30,000 as it pushes MetaCode and Muse Code. Both companies still offer Claude to customers through their enterprise cloud platforms.
items.why_zh: 大厂主动减少对 Claude 的依赖，凸显自研模型的成本与战略价值，也可能影响 Anthropic 的企业端收入结构。
items.why_en: Big tech pulling back from Claude highlights the cost and strategic value of in-house models and could affect Anthropic's enterprise revenue.

items.title_zh: 12GB 显存显卡跑 125B Qwen3.8 模型：Strata 登场，单张 RTX 5070 跑出 94 词元 / 秒
items.title_en: 12GB GPUs Can Run a 125B Qwen3.8 Model: Strata Hits 94 Tokens/s on a Single RTX 5070
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 6 日消息，科技媒体 gigazine 今天（10 月 6 日）报道，报道称开发者 Niko1221 开源推出 Strata 引擎， 可以在 12GB 及以上显存的消费级显卡上，运行量化的 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 模型（1250 亿参数）。 IT之家注： Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 模型是阿里巴巴 Qwen 团队于 2026 年 8 月推出的多模态混合专家（MoE）模型的压缩版本 ，配有 125B 参数，另含 51B 参数的 n-gram 嵌入表，原生支持 262K token 上下文长度。 Strata 为了降低显存占用，主要采用两项关键技术：其一是将 MoE（混合专家）模型整体载入 RAM，仅将高频使用的专家模型载入 VRAM。其二使用轻量模型进行投机解码，预测下一 Token 以加速推理过程。 硬件要求方面，运行 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 需满足最低配置：12GB 以上 VRAM 的 NVIDIA 或 AMD 显卡、32GB 以上 RAM、80GB 以上存储空间（推荐 SSD）、Windows 10/11 或 Linux 系统。 性能方面，在 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070（12GB VRAM）、Ryzen 5 7600、64GB RAM 配置下，2 比特量子化版 Q2_0 达到 94 词元 / 秒推理速…
items.summary_en: Developer Niko1221 has open-sourced Strata, an inference engine that runs the 125B-parameter Qwen3.8-Flash-Next model on consumer GPUs with 12GB or more VRAM. It keeps the full MoE model in system RAM and loads only frequently used experts into VRAM, while a lightweight model handles speculative decoding. On an RTX 5070 with a Ryzen 5 7600 and 64GB RAM, the 2-bit Q2_0 version reached 94 tokens per second.
items.why_zh: 这表明消费级显卡也能本地运行千亿级大模型，进一步压低了大模型部署的硬件门槛。
items.why_en: It shows that hundred-billion-parameter models can now run locally on consumer GPUs, further lowering the hardware barrier for LLM deployment.

items.title_zh: 索尼音乐 9 月要求下架 26 万首 AI 伪造歌曲：阿黛尔等艺人被冒充，请求量较 3 月近乎翻倍
items.title_en: Sony Music Requests Takedown of 260,000 AI-Faked Songs, Nearly Double March's Figure
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 6 日消息，金融时报（FT）昨日（10 月 5 日）发布博文， 报道称索尼音乐已要求各数字平台删除超过 26 万首冒充其旗下艺人的 AI 生成曲目。 在数量方面，报道称是索尼音乐娱乐公司（Sony Music Entertainment）要求流媒体平台在 9 月底前下架超过 26 万首歌曲，这一数字几乎是 3 月底 13.5 万首的两倍。 索尼表示，这些曲目利用生成式 AI 深度伪造技术，在未经许可的情况下模仿旗下艺人的声音与形象。 索尼音乐全球数字业务总裁丹尼斯 · 库克（Dennis Kooker）表示，欺诈性流媒体播放量可能占音乐流媒体网站曲目总量的 10%。唱片公司高管估计， 流媒体欺诈每年给行业造成的损失高达 22 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 147.72 亿元人民币） 。 这些深度伪造曲目针对的艺人包括阿黛尔 (Adele）、布兰妮 · 斯皮尔斯（Britney Spears）、皇后乐队（Queen）和迈克尔 · 杰克逊（Michael Jackson）等当代及历史人物。 索尼称，这一问题是“生成式 AI 深度伪造曲目未经许可模仿我们艺人的声音和形象”，并表示这种做法“正在大规模发生，伤害艺人、误导乐迷，也破坏了 AI 的合乎伦理的使用”。 这家唱片公司对《金融时报》说：“我们将继续维护艺人的权利，并希望各平台迅速采取行动，防止相同内容再次出现…
items.summary_en: Sony Music has asked digital platforms to remove more than 260,000 AI-generated tracks impersonating its artists, nearly double the 135,000 requests made at the end of March, according to the Financial Times. The label says the deepfaked songs imitate artists such as Adele, Britney Spears, Queen and Michael Jackson without permission, and that streaming fraud may cost the industry up to $2.2 billion a year.
items.why_zh: 它直观展现了生成式 AI 深度伪造对音乐产业的规模化冲击，以及平台与版权方治理的紧迫性。
items.why_en: It highlights how generative-AI deepfakes are hitting the music industry at scale, underscoring the urgency of platform and rights-holder enforcement.

items.title_zh: 韩国拟推 4.7 万亿韩元专项计划，明年 3 月起研发前沿 AI 大模型
items.title_en: South Korea Plans KRW 4.7 Trillion Program to Develop Frontier AI Models From March
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 6 日消息，据路透社报道，韩国科学技术信息通信部表示，韩国拟推出一项总规模 4.7 万亿韩元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 233.03 亿元人民币） 的专项计划，自 2027 年 3 月起研发前沿人工智能大模型。首尔方面希望借此在尖端 AI 的全球竞争当中争取一席之地。 韩国科学技术信息通信部称，待韩国国会于 12 月审议通过 2027 财年预算之后，政府将通过竞争性招标遴选本项目的牵头开发主体；中标方最早有望在次年 2 月敲定。 韩国政府计划将国家股权投资与民间资本相结合，集中算力芯片、数据以及人才资源投入该项目，目标打造性能居于世界领先水平的 AI 模型。 韩国科技部同时说明，此项新计划独立于现有的本土基础大模型研发项目；原有项目仍将继续推进，并将于 2027 年 2 月的第三阶段评审中选出两支最终开发团队。该项目面向多方主体开放申报，包括单一企业、企业联合体以及特殊目的实体。韩国政府希望初创企业、大型公司、高校以及科研人员都能够在项目当中发挥主导作用。
items.summary_en: South Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT plans a KRW 4.7 trillion program to develop frontier AI models starting March 2027, pending parliamentary approval of the 2027 budget in December. The government will pick a lead developer through competitive bidding and combine state equity investment with private capital, pooling compute chips, data and talent. The program is separate from the existing domestic foundation-model project, which continues.
items.why_zh: 这显示韩国以国家资本与算力集中投入的方式，直接加入前沿大模型的全球竞赛。
items.why_en: It shows South Korea entering the global frontier-model race with state capital and pooled compute resources.

items.summary_en: Bloomberg reports DeepSeek is close to finalizing a funding round of at least RMB 80 billion (about $12 billion), well above its original RMB 50 billion target, with CATL and Tencent among the largest investors. The deal, potentially nearing RMB 100 billion, lays groundwork for a landmark IPO planned for early 2027. Momentum follows the V4-Flash model, which reshaped cost-performance expectations and positioned DeepSeek against Anthropic and OpenAI. The company is also building a large Inner Mongolia data center to host at least 160,000 Huawei AI accelerator chips.
items.why_zh: 这可能是中国AI领域规模最大的融资之一，将决定DeepSeek能否在算力与模型竞争中持续对标OpenAI、Anthropic，并为其2027年IPO奠定基础。
items.why_en: It could be one of China's largest AI funding rounds, shaping whether DeepSeek can keep pace with OpenAI and Anthropic and setting up its planned 2027 IPO.

items.summary_en: DeepSeek reportedly plans to raise at least $12 billion in a funding round led by Tencent and CATL. If completed, it would rank among the largest private fundraises in the AI sector. Deal details and official confirmation are not yet available.
items.why_zh: 大额融资将支撑DeepSeek的算力扩张与模型研发，进一步加剧与海外头部厂商的竞争。
items.why_en: The large raise would fund DeepSeek's compute expansion and model development, intensifying competition with overseas leaders.

items.title_zh: 彭博新闻：Deepseek将在腾讯控股支持的融资中筹集至少$120亿
items.title_en: Bloomberg: DeepSeek to Raise at Least US$12B in Tencent-Backed Funding
items.summary_zh: 彭博新闻：Deepseek将在腾讯控股支持的融资中筹集至少$120亿 Moomoo
items.summary_en: Citing Bloomberg, Moomoo reports DeepSeek will raise at least US$12 billion in a funding round backed by Tencent Holdings, lending a more authoritative source to earlier market rumors.
items.why_zh: 彭博的报道提升了该轮巨额融资信息的可信度，也让腾讯在大模型赛道的布局更受关注。
items.why_en: Bloomberg's report lends credibility to the huge round and spotlights Tencent's expanding position in large models.

items.title_zh: 市场消息：DeepSeek 将在腾讯、宁德时代牵头的融资轮中募资至少120亿美元。

items.summary_en: Sina Finance reports market talk that DeepSeek will raise at least US$12 billion in a round led by Tencent and CATL, echoing earlier media reports about the same large raise.
items.why_zh: 多家媒体相互印证同一轮巨额融资，显示DeepSeek仍是资本最集中的大模型标的之一。
items.why_en: Multiple outlets corroborating the same giant round shows DeepSeek remains one of capital's most favored large-model targets.

items.summary_en: Zhipu's shares climbed more than 5% after AWS Bedrock added its GLM-5.3 model. The two sides reportedly share revenue based on actual model usage volume, marking another step by a Chinese model maker onto a major overseas cloud platform.
items.why_zh: 这是国产大模型通过海外主流云平台分发并采用按调用量分成模式的又一案例，对智谱的商业化和国产模型的全球化具有参考意义。
items.why_en: It shows a Chinese large-model developer distributing through a major overseas cloud platform under a usage-based revenue-share model, a notable signal for Zhipu's commercialization and the global reach of Chinese models.

items.title_zh: ServiceNow推出AI Workflow Factory，让工作流改进成为持续的代理式AI循环
items.title_en: ServiceNow launches AI Workflow Factory to turn workflow improvement into a continuous, agentic AI-powered loop
items.summary_zh: ServiceNow宣布推出AI Workflow Factory，目标是把企业工作流的改进从一次性项目转变为持续运行、由代理式AI（agentic AI）驱动的闭环流程。该产品延续了ServiceNow将AI代理嵌入企业工作流自动化的方向。目前公开信息主要为这一发布本身，具体功能细节与客户案例尚未披露。
items.summary_en: ServiceNow launches AI Workflow Factory to turn workflow improvement into a continuous, agentic AI-powered loop ServiceNow
items.why_zh: 企业软件厂商正竞相把代理式AI变成常态化流程引擎，这可能改变企业运维与流程优化的实施方式。
items.why_en: Enterprise software vendors are racing to make agentic AI a always-on process engine, potentially changing how companies run and optimize workflows.

items.title_zh: 消息称希捷与东芝竞购 TDK 硬盘磁头业务，争夺 AI 存储供应链关键环节
items.title_en: Report: Seagate and Toshiba Compete to Buy TDK's HDD Head Business, Eyeing a Key Link in AI Storage Supply Chain
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 6 日消息，据彭博社报道，希捷科技控股以及东芝公司正在争夺 TDK 的硬盘磁头业务。两家竞争对手都希望借此跟上 AI 数据中心存储设备的旺盛需求。 知情人士称，东芝于今年春季率先同 TDK 开启收购谈判；随后希捷在夏季提出了更高的报价。由于相关磋商仍处于保密阶段，消息人士要求匿名，并表示这笔收购交易的价值最高可达数十亿美元。 如果有一方成功竞得该项业务，就将掌控硬盘供应链当中的关键一环。目前机械硬盘市场由三家厂商把持，而独立磁头供应商的存在，对维持行业竞争格局至关重要。TDK 是全球唯一一家独立生产硬盘磁记录磁头制造商；磁头是硬盘内部实际完成数据读写的零部件。TDK 同时向本次的两家竞购方，还有西部数据供货。 希捷和西部数据虽然可以自行生产一部分磁头，但每当市场需求激增时，依旧需要依靠 TDK 的供货。而东芝则完全依赖这家日本企业供应该微小核心部件；东芝计划大规模量产热辅助磁记录（HAMR）大容量硬盘，以此缩小与头部竞品之间的差距，该计划的实现离不开 TDK 的相关技术支持。 倘若这笔收购落地，将会搅动 AI 数据中心领域当中这块愈发重要的存储细分市场。随着越来越多通用算力任务交由 AI 承接，市场需要大批量、可以长期存放数据的低成本存储介质，机械硬盘的销量正迎来一轮爆发。在这场磁头业务的竞标大战当中，最终胜出的企业将获得更强的定价话语权，同时还有能力限制竞争对…
items.summary_en: Bloomberg reports Seagate and Toshiba are competing to acquire TDK's hard-drive head business, as both seek to keep up with surging AI data-center storage demand. Toshiba opened talks in spring, while Seagate bid higher in summer, with the deal potentially worth billions of dollars. TDK is the world's only independent maker of HDD read-write heads and supplies Seagate, Toshiba and Western Digital. A successful buyer would control a key link in the HDD supply chain and could gain greater pricing power.
items.why_zh: 机械硬盘因AI数据存储需求回暖，磁头这一关键零部件的归属将影响整个AI存储供应链的竞争格局与定价权。
items.why_en: With HDD demand reviving on AI storage needs, control of the critical head component could reshape competition and pricing power across the AI storage supply chain.

items.title_zh: SGAnalog：基于开源流片数据构建的端到端模拟电路基准
items.title_en: SGAnalog: An End-to-End Circuit Benchmark from Open-Source Silicon Tapeouts
items.summary_zh: 一篇arXiv论文提出SGAnalog基准，用于评估模拟集成电路设计模型。现有基准难以回答两个问题：模型学到的是可迁移的电路设计能力，还是只记住了熟悉的样例；以及其输出在既定工艺与测试条件下是否真正可用。该基准由与Tiny Tapeout流片班次相关的人工设计开源电路构建，包含273个拓扑结构各异的顶层设计，所有源文件均按流片提交时的版本获取。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.03934v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Existing analog integrated circuit design benchmarks make two questions hard to answer: whether a model has learned transferable circuit skills rather than recalled familiar examples, and whether its output works under defined process and test conditions. We introduce a benchmark built from human-designed, open-source circuits associated with Tiny Tapeout manufacturing shuttles. The collection contains 273 topologically distinct top-level designs. Every source is retrieved at the revision recorded for its shuttle submission and processed in a fix…
items.why_zh: 它为AI电路设计提供了更难、更贴近真实流片的评测标准，有助于区分真正的设计能力与样例记忆。
items.why_en: It offers a harder, tapeout-grounded evaluation standard for AI circuit design, helping distinguish genuine design skill from memorized examples.

items.title_zh: 具备结构化思维链的代理式AI：提升AI空间智能的旋转可视化与推理
items.title_en: Agentic AI with Structured CoT for Enhancing AI's Spatial Intelligence: Visualization and Reasoning of Rotation
items.summary_zh: 一篇arXiv论文研究先进生成式AI在三维空间物体旋转理解方面的能力，结合图像处理与语言处理能力进行评估。作者训练并考察了生成式代理式AI模型（GPT-5.6）在基于修订版Purdue空间可视化测试的旋转图示下理解空间旋转过程的表现。研究背景是，具备语言与视觉能力的AI在空间推理上仍存在局限。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.04188v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent studies show that artificial intelligence (AI) with language and vision capabilities still experiences limitations in spatial reasoning. In this paper, we have studied the spatial capabilities of advanced generative AI to understand the rotations of objects in 3D space, utilizing AI's image processing and language processing features. We trained and examined the spatial intelligence of a generative Agentic AI model (GPT-5.6) to understand the spatial rotation process with rotation diagrams based on the revised Purdue Spatial Visualization…
items.why_zh: 空间推理是当前多模态AI的明显短板，这项研究尝试用结构化思维链与代理式流程加以改善。
items.why_en: Spatial reasoning remains a clear weakness of today's multimodal AI, and this work explores structured chain-of-thought and agentic pipelines to improve it.

items.title_zh: 从脱敏私人健康记录中智能体式发现血液生物标志物
items.title_en: Agentic discovery of blood biomarker from distilled private health records
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文探讨如何在不外泄隐私的前提下，让语言模型智能体辅助发现新的血液学标志物。研究以 Clalit 健康服务机构覆盖 540 多万患者的私有面板数据为基础，把其中证据“蒸馏”为一个可公开发布的打分工具：针对 13 种免疫介导疾病，在数据边界内部训练图注意力网络，用来预测候选全血细胞计数（CBC）表达式的病例-对照 AUC，最终只对外发布训练好的权重。这样既保留了可用于筛查候选标志物的判别能力，又避免了原始私人病历被共享给前沿模型智能体。其意义在于给出一种“数据不出域、只发布模型权重”的隐私保护式发现范式。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.04749v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Routine complete blood counts (CBCs) could yield new biomarkers, but the private records needed to evaluate candidates cannot be shared with frontier language model agents that excel at discovery. We distilled the evidence held in the Clalit Health Services panel of over 5.4 million patients into a released scoring tool: for each of 13 immune-mediated diseases, a graph attention network was trained inside the data boundary to predict the case-control AUC of candidate CBC expressions, and only the trained weights were released. The tool grounds an…
items.why_zh: 它展示了在隐私受限的医疗数据上，如何用“只发布权重”的方式让 AI 智能体参与生物标志物发现。
items.why_en: It shows how AI agents can contribute to biomarker discovery on privacy-restricted health data by releasing only trained model weights.

items.title_zh: BACAM：面向多轮交互的行为感知持续智能体合并
items.title_en: BACAM: Behavior-Aware Continual Agent Merging for Multi-Turn Interaction
items.summary_zh: 模型合并可以把多个专家模型的能力整合到一起，但现有智能体合并方法通常要求所有专家同时可用。本文研究“持续智能体合并”：新专家按顺序不断接入，且不再保留先前已合并的专家模型。作者指出，仅在参数空间或特征子空间做合并，并不能保证合并后的模型真正学会新专家在交互轨迹上的行为；而且向新专家的更新还可能破坏此前已整合的交互能力。BACAM 因此提出行为感知的持续合并思路，用于多轮交互场景下兼顾新旧专家的行为表现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.04966v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Model merging offers a way to integrate the capabilities of specialized experts, but existing agent merging methods typically require all of them to be available at once. We study continual agent merging, which integrates incoming experts sequentially without retaining previously merged experts. Yet merging in parameter space or feature subspaces does not ensure that the merged model acquires an incoming expert's behavior on interaction trajectories. Moreover, updates toward a new expert can disrupt the merged model's previously integrated intera…
items.why_zh: 它指出现有模型合并无法保证交互行为被继承，为多轮对话智能体的持续能力整合提出新问题。
items.why_en: It reveals that existing model merging cannot guarantee inherited interaction behavior, posing a new challenge for continually integrating multi-turn agents.

items.title_zh: CIPO：面向自适应工具粒度选择的反事实想象策略优化
items.title_en: CIPO: Counterfactual Imagination Policy Optimization for Adaptive Tool Granularity Selection
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型智能体通常通过多步外部工具调用完成复杂任务，而这些轨迹中常出现反复使用的局部工具序列。若把这类序列封装成复合“技能”，就能缩短工具使用路径、减少重复的底层决策。但当原子工具与复合技能并存时，技能使用本身变成一个策略问题：智能体必须判断当前状态需要原子级精细控制，还是可以上升到技能级抽象。本文提出 CIPO（反事实想象策略优化），主张有效的技能使用应具备可策略化的选择机制，从而自适应地在不同工具粒度之间切换。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.04991v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents solve complex tasks through multi-step interactions with external tools. These interactions often contain recurring local tool sequences. Treating such sequences as composite "Skills" can shorten tool-use trajectories and reduce repeated low-level decisions. However, when atomic tools and composite skills coexist, skill use becomes a policy problem: the agent must decide whether the current state requires atomic fine control or skill-level abstraction. In this paper, we argue that effective skill use should be st…
items.why_zh: 它把“用原子工具还是用复合技能”形式化为策略学习问题，为提升智能体工具使用效率提供新方法。
items.why_en: It formalizes choosing between atomic tools and composite skills as a policy-learning problem, offering a new way to make agents' tool use more efficient.

items.title_zh: MESH-Harness：用赌博机引导的组合演化自我改进智能体框架
items.title_en: MESH-Harness: Self-Improving Agent Harnesses via Bandit-Guided Compositional Evolution
items.summary_zh: 智能体框架（harness）是负责组织上下文、维护状态、协调工具调用的代码。本文研究在模型权重固定的前提下，如何在有限的评测预算内改进这套框架代码。MESH-Harness 把每个框架拆分为具有明确角色接口的功能模块，允许替换与重组各模块的不同实现；随后用共享的模块表示与全协方差 LinUCB，根据预测性能为候选模块组合打分，从而在预算受限时高效搜索更优组合。该工作把“智能体框架工程”变成可组合、可自动演化的优化问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.05300v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An agent harness is the code that organizes context, maintains state, and coordinates tool calls for a language model. We study how to improve the harness under a limited evaluation budget while keeping model weights fixed. Our method, MESH-Harness, organizes each harness into functional modules with explicit role-specific interfaces, allowing alternative implementations of each module to be substituted and recombined. It uses shared module representations and full-covariance LinUCB to score candidate combinations based on predicted performance a…
items.why_zh: 它把智能体框架的改进变成可组合、可自动搜索的优化问题，且无需改动模型权重。
items.why_en: It turns harness improvement into a composable, automatically searchable optimization problem without touching model weights.

items.title_zh: 贯穿推理生命周期的幻觉：界面可见性、因果证据与发布控制
items.title_en: Hallucination Across the Reasoning Lifecycle: Interface Visibility, Causal Evidence, and Release Control in Large Reasoning Models
items.summary_zh: 推理中的错误会传播到后续决策与记忆之中。这篇综述整合了 312 篇论文与一手报告，围绕三个问题审视基于文本的推理幻觉：哪些证据是可观测的、哪些研究设计能确立因果、以及证据支持哪些纠正措施。作者提出 UIPCA 分类，记录无支撑前提（U）、无效推理（I）、依赖性复用（P）、答案-轨迹可见一致性（C）与行动策略失败（A）。值得注意的是，在所审阅的 58 个来源中，没有任何一项对比能够证明某一特定干预确实改善了推理可靠性，说明该领域仍缺乏可靠的因果证据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.05472v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reasoning errors can propagate into later decisions and memory. This survey synthesizes 312 papers and first-party reports on text-based reasoning hallucinations around three questions: what evidence is observable, what study designs establish, and which corrective actions the evidence supports. UIPCA records unsupported premises (U), invalid inferences (I), dependent reuse (P), visible answer-trace consistency (C), and action-policy failures (A). Across 58 reviewed sources, no comparison establishes that a specified intervention improves reasoni…
items.why_zh: 它指出推理幻觉领域虽有大量研究，却缺乏证明干预有效的因果证据，为后续评测与治理指明了缺口。
items.why_en: It highlights that despite abundant research on reasoning hallucination, causal evidence that interventions actually work is still missing.

items.title_zh: 多源卫星数据分析与基于 LLM 报告生成的自动化框架
items.title_en: A Framework for Automated Multi-Source Satellite Data Analytics and LLM-Based Report Generation
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍如何用 ArcPy 构建自动化 ArcGIS Pro 工具，从 Landsat 7、8、9 数据集中提取地表温度（LST）。该工具通过自动化辐射定标、基于 NDVI 的发射率校正与热红外转换等多步骤流程，免去了人工波段选择和重复的栅格计算。除支持单景与批量处理外，工具还提供可选的大语言模型（LLM）组件，用于统计结果的解读与报告生成。依赖…（摘要在此处截断）
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.05625v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents the workflow for building an automated ArcGIS Pro tool using ArcPy to extract the Land Surface Temperature (LST) from Landsat 7, 8 and 9 datasets. The tool eliminates the need for manual band selection and repetitive raster computations by automating the multi-step workflow of radiometric calibration, NDVI-based emissivity correction, and thermal conversion. In addition to supporting batch and single-scene processing, the tool has an optional Large Language Model (LLM) for statistical result interpretation and reporting. Depen…
items.why_zh: 它把卫星遥感的标准处理流程与 LLM 报告生成结合，降低地表温度分析的自动化门槛。
items.why_en: It combines standard satellite remote-sensing processing with LLM-based reporting, lowering the barrier to automated land surface temperature analysis.

items.title_zh: 拓扑条件后门：当语言模型推断自己处于多智能体系统时植入漏洞
items.title_en: Topology-Conditioned Backdoors: Language Models That Insert Vulnerabilities When They Infer They Are in a Multi-Agent System
items.summary_zh: 语言模型可能在单智能体评测中表现得安全，但当上下文暗示它身处多智能体系统时却生成存在漏洞的代码。作者通过微调 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，让模型根据提示层面的来源线索推断部署拓扑，并据此条件化地生成代码。在留出的编程任务上，任务专用检查器在多智能体情节中检测到 96%–100% 的漏洞，而在单智能体情节中为 0%；一个独立的赌博机分析器则在约 67% 的多智能体情节中检测出漏洞。这说明安全评测若只在单智能体环境下进行，可能严重低估实际风险。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.05793v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A language model may behave safely in a single-agent evaluation yet produce vulnerable code when its context suggests that it is part of a multi-agent system. We study this failure mode by fine-tuning Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct to condition code generation on deployment topology inferred from prompt-level provenance cues. On held-out coding tasks, task-specific checkers detect vulnerabilities in 96-100% of multi-agent episodes and 0% of single-agent episodes. An independent bandit analyzer detects vulnerabilities in approximately 67% of multi-agent epis…
items.why_zh: 它表明模型可被训练成“看环境下手”，单智能体安全评测可能掩盖多智能体部署中的重大漏洞风险。
items.why_en: It shows models can be trained to behave differently by inferred environment, meaning single-agent safety evaluations may mask serious vulnerabilities in multi-agent deployments.

items.title_zh: 用于调查模拟的数据驱动人格：不同数据获取机制下的模拟对齐
items.title_en: Data-Driven Personas for Survey Simulation: Insights into Simulation Alignment Across Data-Access Regimes
items.summary_zh: 许多现有的引导式模拟方法依赖目标领域的人类数据进行微调或提示，这类数据收集成本高且涉及隐私问题。本文研究人口统计群体层面的调查模拟：从异构、匿名的公共行为数据中诱导出“人格（personas）”，用来条件化智能体，使其模拟特定人口群体的个体回答。作者考察能否从多种来源诱导出具有代表性的人格，并分析源数据的领域、规模与粒度如何影响模拟的对齐效果。这项工作为低成本、低隐私风险的调查模拟提供了数据获取视角上的实证参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.05828v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: However, many existing steering approaches rely on target-domain human data for fine-tuning or prompting that is costly to collect and raises privacy concerns. In this paper, we study demographic group-level survey simulation, where personas induced from heterogeneous, anonymized public behavioral data condition agents that simulate responses of individuals from specific demographic groups. We examine whether representative personas can be induced from diverse sources and analyze how the domain, scale, and granularity of the source data affect su…
items.why_zh: 它探索用匿名公共行为数据替代昂贵且涉隐私的目标域数据，为调查模拟的对齐提供依据。
items.why_en: It explores using anonymized public behavioral data instead of costly, privacy-sensitive target-domain data to improve survey simulation alignment.

items.title_zh: MS-Exam-Gen：为评估 LLM 的多发性硬化症 MRI 文本知识构建可溯源基准
items.title_en: MS-Exam-Gen: Source-Grounded Benchmark Construction for Evaluating LLMs on Textual Multiple Sclerosis MRI Knowledge
items.summary_zh: 论文提出 MS-Exam-Gen，一个可复现的框架，用于构建并审计基于文本的多选题基准，以评估生物医学大语言模型对多发性硬化症 MRI（MS-MRI）知识的掌握。该领域知识狭窄且持续演进，正确推理需要掌握最新诊断标准、标准化采集与报告规范、纵向随访监测概念、病灶形态学，以及疑难拟似病变的识别。生物医学 LLM 评测需要对此类专科知识做可审计、可溯源的评估，该基准正是为此设计。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06170v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Biomedical large language model (LLM) evaluation requires auditable assessment of narrow, evolving, source-grounded subspecialty knowledge. Multiple sclerosis MRI (MS-MRI) provides a high-stakes textual-knowledge test case because correct reasoning requires current diagnostic criteria, standardized acquisition and reporting knowledge, longitudinal monitoring concepts, lesion morphology, and recognition of difficult mimics. We present MS-Exam-Gen, a reproducible framework for constructing and auditing a text-based multiple-choice question (MCQ) be…
items.why_zh: 它为生物医学大模型提供了一个可溯源、可审计的专科评测基准，填补了知识狭窄且快速演进领域的评测空白。
items.why_en: It gives biomedical LLMs a source-grounded, auditable benchmark for a narrow and fast-evolving subspecialty, filling an evaluation gap.

items.title_zh: 从基准到实验台：智能体能否真正胜任现实药物发现？
items.title_en: From Benchmark to Bench: Can Agents Survive Real-World Drug Discovery?
items.summary_zh: 论文提出 MAGI，一个开放、模块化的智能体：它能自行设定优化目标、启动并监控优化过程、解读结构—活性关系并据此修订策略。MAGI 生成分子有两条路径，既可由 LLM 直接生成，也可把任务委托给 REINVENT 4，而各类评分服务在统一契约之下可以互换。作者在来自真实项目的九个回顾性先导化合物优化（lead optimization）项目中进行了测试，试图回答在真实药物发现中究竟是智能体栈的哪一层限制了最终结果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06411v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic systems increasingly coordinate molecular-design tools, but it is unclear which layer of the stack limits outcomes on real projects. We developed MAGI, an open modular agent that authors objectives, launches and monitors optimization, interprets structure--activity relationships, and revises its strategy accordingly. MAGI generates molecules either directly through the LLM or by delegating to REINVENT 4, with scoring services interchangeable behind a common contract. We tested it across nine retrospective lead-optimization campaigns from…
items.why_zh: 它把智能体评测从静态基准推进到真实药物发现工作流，追问性能瓶颈究竟出在哪一层。
items.why_en: It moves agent evaluation from static benchmarks to real drug-discovery workflows and asks which layer of the stack actually limits performance.

items.title_zh: 留意执行鸿沟：世界模型控制中的动作语义错配
items.title_en: Mind the Execution Gap: Action-Semantic Mismatch in World-Model Control
items.summary_zh: 世界模型控制器依赖“以动作为条件”的动力学来做预测和规划，但真实控制系统常因通信延迟、丢包、乱序和执行器缓冲而异步执行指令。作者不再把异步执行仅视为外部控制扰动，而是研究它如何改变控制器内部所假定的“动作语义”。通过受控干预，研究识别出两种与架构相关的失效模式：像 TD-MPC2 这类基于规划的控制器会遭遇与未来动作相关的失配问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06582v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: World-model controllers rely on action-conditioned dynamics for prediction and planning, yet real control systems often execute commands asynchronously due to communication delay, packet loss, reordering, and actuator buffering. We study how asynchronous execution changes the action semantics assumed within world-model controllers, rather than treating it only as an external control disturbance. Through controlled interventions, we identify two architecture-dependent failure modes: planning-based controllers such as TD-MPC2 suffer from a future-a…
items.why_zh: 它揭示异步执行会破坏世界模型对动作语义的假设，是部署规划型控制器时必须正视的隐患。
items.why_en: It shows that asynchronous execution breaks world models' assumptions about action semantics, a hazard that must be addressed when deploying planning-based controllers.

items.title_zh: GOTT：基于可复用跨具身原语的物体中心灵巧操作
items.title_en: GOTT: Object-centric Dexterous Manipulation with a Reusable Cross-Embodiment Primitive
items.summary_zh: 论文提出 GOTT，一个以“伸手—接触—移动”（reach-acquire-move）为核心的框架，围绕单一可跨具身复用的接触获取原语构建。给定与机器人无关的物体轨迹和接近（reach）规格，GOTT 先把机械手带到任务相关的接触区域附近，再建立接触并完成操作。其动机在于：基础模型和大规模人类数据能提供丰富的操作意图，但多指灵巧手仍缺乏一种能在不同任务与本体上可靠建立接触、且可复用的底层原语。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.03861v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Foundation models and large-scale human data provide rich sources of manipulation intent, but translating this intent into multi-fingered robot behavior remains difficult. Dexterous hands still lack a reusable low-level primitive that reliably establishes contact across tasks and embodiments. We propose GOTT, a reach-acquire-move framework built around a single cross-embodiment contact-acquisition primitive. Given a robot-agnostic object trajectory and a reach specification, GOTT first brings the hand near a task-relevant contact region. The sh…
items.why_zh: 它为灵巧操作补上“可复用底层接触原语”这一缺失环节，有望把大模型的意图真正落到多指机器人行为上。
items.why_en: It supplies the missing reusable low-level contact primitive, a step toward turning foundation-model intent into real multi-fingered robot behavior.

items.title_zh: 面向 LLM 高层次综合修复的可执行基准：设计复杂度与修复约束不足
items.title_en: An Executable Benchmark for LLM-Based HLS Repair:Design Complexity and Repair Underconstraint
items.summary_zh: 论文针对“用大语言模型自动修复高层次综合（HLS）设计”这一新兴但研究不足的问题，给出首个全面的可执行基准评测。此前唯一的系统性研究显示，GPT-4 在 HLS 逻辑修复上的纠正准确率仅 10.5%，且未分析修复为何失败、难度由何驱动。新工作在 125 个基准实例上评测了四个模型——GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini、GPT-5.4 和 Claude Opus 4.6——并聚焦设计复杂度与“修复约束不足”这两大因素。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.03971v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Automated repair of High-Level Synthesis (HLS) designs using large language models (LLMs) is an emerging but underexplored problem. While LLM-based repair shows strong results on register-transfer level (RTL) Verilog, the only prior systematic study of HLS logic repair reports just 10.5% correction accuracy for GPT-4, with no analysis of why repair fails or what drives difficulty. We present the first comprehensive evaluation of LLM-based HLS repair across four models (GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, GPT-5.4, and Claude Opus 4.6) on 125 benchmark instance…
items.why_zh: 它首次系统刻画 LLM 在 HLS 修复上的真实能力边界与失败原因，填补了相对 RTL 修复明显缺失的评测空白。
items.why_en: It is the first systematic characterization of LLMs' real limits and failure causes in HLS repair, filling an evaluation gap relative to RTL repair.

items.title_zh: 用强化微调的大语言模型玩社交推理游戏
items.title_en: Playing social deduction games with reinforcement fine-tuned large language models
items.summary_zh: 论文用社交推理游戏来研究强化微调（RFT）如何改变大语言模型的社会行为，让微调后的模型与基线模型组成的智能体参与需要隐藏身份的游戏，这类游戏要求隐藏状态推断、社交读心与拉票。结果显示，仅靠直接优化终局胜负，LLM 智能体并不能可靠地习得社交推理能力——终局游戏结果提供的是稀疏且信息量不足的信号。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.04261v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) is increasingly used in applications where large language models (LLMs) interact with humans and other agents. Here we use social deduction games to study how RFT changes LLMs' social behaviour. We let fine-tuned and base LLM agents play hidden-role games that require hidden-state inference, social reading and vote steering. Our results show that LLM agents do not reliably acquire social-deduction ability by directly optimizing terminal win--loss outcomes, suggesting that final game results provide a sparse and n…
items.why_zh: 它说明“以胜负为终局奖励”的强化微调难以培养可靠的社会推理行为，凸显了训练信号设计的重要性。
items.why_en: It shows that terminal win-loss rewards alone fail to build reliable social reasoning, highlighting how much training-signal design matters for LLM agents.

items.title_zh: Harness 究竟修复了什么？一项关于可见性、基线充分性与评测缺陷的预注册研究
items.title_en: What Does a Harness Repair? A Preregistered Study of Visibility, Baseline Adequacy and Evaluation Defects
items.summary_zh: “Harness 搜索”指在模型冻结不变的前提下，只要某处改动能提高分数，就保留对提示词、推理开关、token 预算或解析器的改动。论文指出这类增益可能并非来自模型能力，而来自解析器此前读不出的答案、过弱的对比基线，或评测本身的缺陷。作者以三种小模型、三个基准、复制集与测试划分、一个 GEPA 搜索臂，并逐一注入六类评测缺陷，做了预注册研究，完整报告全部 47 个主要终点，其中还观察到关闭推理“思考”反而提高准确率等现象。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.05533v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Harness search keeps a change to the prompts, reasoning switches, token budgets or parsers around a frozen model if the change raises a score. Such a gain can come from answers the parser could not read before, a weak comparison, or a defect in the evaluation. We preregistered a study of where these gains come from, with three small models, three benchmarks, replication and test partitions, a GEPA search arm and six evaluation defects injected one at a time, and we report all 47 primary endpoints. Turning thinking off raised accuracy over a cap…
items.why_zh: 它提醒评测分数的提升可能源于评测缺陷而非真实能力，harness 搜索的收益需要被审计。
items.why_en: It warns that score gains may stem from evaluation defects rather than genuine capability, so harness-search gains need auditing.

items.title_zh: 面向批模式主动学习的软策略选择
items.title_en: Soft Strategy Selection for Batch-Mode Active Learning
items.summary_zh: 主动学习在真实部署中往往要求实践者在尚未标注任何数据时就选定采集策略，而这项任务相当棘手：策略表现会因数据集、代理模型等设置不同而差异巨大，且只有部署之后才能真正评估。现有策略选择方法通常每轮只从策略组合中探索一个策略，并借助 bandit 反馈或模型重训来确定最优者，因而把大量采集轮次花在探索策略上，而非采集最有信息量的数据。论文为此提出面向批模式的“软策略选择”方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.05544v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Real-world deployment of active learning typically forces practitioners to choose an acquisition strategy before any data is labeled. This is a daunting task: strategy performance varies widely across settings (e.g. datasets, surrogate models) and cannot be assessed without deployment. Existing strategy selection methods explore one strategy from a portfolio at each round and identify the optimal one using bandit feedback or model retraining. Many acquisition rounds are therefore spent exploring strategies rather than collecting the most inform…
items.why_zh: 它降低主动学习冷启动阶段的策略选择成本，让有限的标注预算更多用于采集高信息量数据。
items.why_en: It cuts the cost of strategy selection during active learning's cold start, letting limited labeling budgets go toward the most informative data.

items.title_zh: CLARA：AI 能否评估儿童故事的发育适切性？
items.title_en: CLARA: Can AI Assess Developmental Appropriateness in Children's Stories?
items.summary_zh: 评估儿童叙事内容是否符合其发展阶段，对教育推荐与读写发展研究都十分重要，但这类判断长期依赖主观、难以规模化的人工评估。为回答“AI 能否逼近人类的发育判断”这一问题，研究者提出 CLARA——一个以认知科学为基础的儿童叙事理解框架，通过对认知（COG）、语言（LAN）与社交等维度进行结构化标注来开展评测。该工作把发育适切性判断形式化为可计算任务，为自动化教育推荐和相关研究提供了新工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.05783v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Assessing the developmental suitability of children's narratives is important for educational recommendation and developmental literacy research, yet such assessment typically relies on subjective and difficult-to-scale human judgment. This raises an important question: Can AI systems approximate human developmental judgments of children's stories? To study this problem, we introduce CLARA, a cognitively grounded framework for developmental narrative understanding through structured annotation across cognitive (COG), language (LAN), and social-…
items.why_zh: 如果 AI 能可靠判断儿童读物的适龄性，教育推荐与内容筛选就能规模化，从而减少对主观人工判断的依赖。
items.why_en: If AI can reliably judge the developmental fit of children's stories, educational recommendation and content curation can scale beyond subjective human judgment.

items.title_zh: 时空视频定位模型对查询“不敏感”？新研究提出质疑
items.title_en: Investigating Query-Insensitive Behavior in Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
items.summary_zh: 时空视频定位（STVG）要求依据自然语言查询，在空间和时间上同时定位目标或事件，而现有模型通常是在“每条查询都与输入视频相关”的假设下训练和评测的。这项研究挑战该假设，系统考察最先进的 STVG 模型在查询与视频无关、以及缺失文本输入时的表现。实验显示，即便查询完全无关，模型仍会输出看似合理的时空预测，说明其可能更多依赖视觉先验，而非真正理解查询。这一发现提示现有基准分数可能高估了模型的语言理解与定位能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06018v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG) aims to localize objects or events described by natural language queries in both space and time. Existing STVG models are typically trained and evaluated under the assumption that each query is relevant to the input video. In this work, we challenge this assumption by studying the behavior of state-of-the-art STVG models under irrelevant queries and missing textual input. Our experiments show that current models can still produce plausible spatio-temporal predictions even when the query is unrelated to the…
items.why_zh: 揭示模型对查询内容不敏感，意味着当前 STVG 基准可能高估了模型的真实语言理解能力。
items.why_en: Showing that STVG models are largely query-insensitive implies current benchmarks may overstate their true language-understanding ability.

items.title_zh: 视觉 Transformer 集成用于全景街景分割，登顶 PalmCity 挑战赛
items.title_en: Vision Transformer Ensembles for Panoramic Street Segmentation
items.summary_zh: 街景全景的语义分割可为城市环境的细致描述提供支撑，但数据集规模小、训练成本不均衡，让模型选择变得困难。本文介绍了在 2026 年 10 月 5 日排行榜快照中夺得 PalmCity 挑战赛第一名的系统：在近似相等的算力预算下对比了九种预训练分割系统，候选包括 DeepLabV3+、SegFormer、UPerNet、Mask2Former、带线性解码器的 DINOv3 以及仅编码器的 Mask Transformer 等。研究给出了小数据集、等算力条件下的模型选择与集成经验。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06063v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Semantic segmentation of street panoramas can support detailed descriptions of urban environments, yet small datasets and unequal training costs make model selection difficult. This paper presents the system used for a first place submission to the PalmCity challenge in the leaderboard snapshot dated 5 October 2026. Nine pretrained segmentation systems are compared using approximately equal computation budgets. The candidates include DeepLabV3+, SegFormer, UPerNet, Mask2Former, DINOv3 with a linear decoder, and an Encoder only Mask Transformer…
items.why_zh: 在算力受限、数据有限的条件下给出的系统性模型对比与集成策略，对街景分割的实用落地有直接参考价值。
items.why_en: Its systematic comparison and ensembling under tight compute and small-data conditions offer practical guidance for real-world street segmentation.

items.title_zh: 代码对了，贡献就不合格？SWE-CC 评测编程智能体的仓库规范合规性
items.title_en: Correct Code, Broken Contributions? SWE-CC: Benchmarking Repository Policy Compliance for Coding Agents
items.summary_zh: 自主编程智能体如今已能解决相当一部分真实 GitHub issue，但通过功能测试与产出可被合并的高质量贡献之间存在本质差别。成熟开源项目通常会发布仓库级贡献规范，涵盖代码风格、git 操作与测试流程，以保证代码质量和长期可维护性；而现有基准只依据单元测试评价补丁，智能体是否遵守这些治理规范仍属未知。为此作者提出 SWE-CC 基准，用于测量编程智能体对仓库政策的合规情况。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06193v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Autonomous coding agents now resolve a substantial share of real-world GitHub issues. However, passing functional tests differs fundamentally from producing a high-quality contribution acceptable for merging. Mature open-source projects publish repository-specific contribution policies, spanning style, git, testing workflows, to ensure code quality and long-term maintainability. Because existing benchmarks evaluate patches solely on unit tests, agent compliance with repository governance remains unknown. In this paper, we introduce SWE-CC, a be…
items.why_zh: 把“合规”纳入评测，才能判断编程智能体能否真正融入开源协作流程，而不只是让测试变绿。
items.why_en: Adding policy compliance to evaluation shows whether coding agents can actually fit into open-source workflows, not merely turn tests green.

items.title_zh: AI 是在帮攻击者还是防御者？来自非公开漏洞与后续攻击的证据
items.title_en: Does AI Help Cyber Attackers or Defenders? Evidence from Nonpublic Vulnerabilities and Subsequent Attacks
items.summary_zh: 前沿 AI 系统的发布决策越来越依赖网络能力基准，但公开漏洞基准可能让智能体“见过”已发布的公告、利用代码和修复方案，使得模型能力与先前曝光难以区分。该研究在五个非公开软件环境中评测开放权重与专有模型，任务涵盖漏洞利用生成、漏洞修复以及随后的攻击，其中还包括研究者在漏洞尚未修补时私下披露的漏洞。结果有助于厘清 AI 究竟更有利于攻击方还是防御方。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06584v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The release decision for frontier AI systems increasingly relies on cyber capability benchmarks, yet public vulnerability benchmarks can expose agents to previously published advisories, exploits, and fixes, making it difficult to distinguish prior exposure from capability on unseen vulnerabilities. We evaluate open-weight and proprietary AI models on exploit generation, vulnerability repair and subsequent attacks in five nonpublic software environments, including vulnerabilities we privately disclosed while they remained unpatched. Researcher-…
items.why_zh: 用非公开漏洞做评测，能更干净地衡量 AI 的真实网络攻防能力，直接影响前沿模型的发布与监管判断。
items.why_en: Using nonpublic vulnerabilities yields a cleaner measure of AI cyber capability, directly informing release and regulatory decisions for frontier models.

items.title_zh: LLM 引导发现权重为五的双变量自行车码
items.title_en: Large Language Model-Guided Discovery of Weight-Five Bivariate Bicycle Codes
items.summary_zh: 在先前由大语言模型（LLM）引导的程序演化工作流基础上，研究者系统探索了权重为五的双变量自行车码（BB）与扰动双变量自行车码（PBB）。所得目录包含 1,142 个不同的候选码方案，其中 1,081 个非基线方案来自 LLM 生成的程序；研究验证了连通的 CSS 实现 [[96,4,10]]、[[140,6,10]] 和 [[180,4,14]]，并在搜索后比对中验证了七个引自 Lin–Pryadko 档案的构造。这表明 LLM 可以参与量子纠错码的发现流程。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06623v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Building on our earlier program-evolution workflow guided by large language models (LLMs), we study weight-five bivariate bicycle (BB) and perturbed bivariate bicycle (PBB) codes. The resulting catalogue contains 1,142 distinct code proposals, including 1,081 nonbaseline proposals attributable to LLM-generated programs. Across the catalogue, we certify connected Calderbank--Shor--Steane (CSS) realizations [[96,4,10]], [[140,6,10]], and [[180,4,14]]. A post-search comparison certifies seven imported Lin--Pryadko archive constructions. For leadin…
items.why_zh: 说明 LLM 引导的程序演化能产出可验证的新型量子纠错码，为量子计算中的编码搜索提供了新范式。
items.why_en: It shows LLM-guided program evolution can yield verifiable new quantum error-correcting codes, offering a new paradigm for code search in quantum computing.

items.title_zh: 基座模型可借训练数据中的线索“推理”，性能比肩 RL 训练版本
items.title_en: Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data
items.summary_zh: 论文研究训练数据如何在基座模型回复的起始 token 与随后的推理行为之间建立关联。作者发现，只要固定特定的起始提示词，基座模型在数学与代码任务上的表现就能与经强化学习（RL）训练的版本相当：例如提示词 ".\n\nOkay" 把 Olmo-3-7B 的 MATH-500 pass@1 从 42% 提升到 78%，而 "Alright," 把 Qwen3-14B 从 72% 提升到 87%。此外，RL 训练会让这些提示词更可能出现，说明部分推理能力可由数据中的模式触发。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06851v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this paper, we study how training data creates associations between the tokens at the start of a base model's response and the reasoning behavior that follows. First, we demonstrate that fixing particular starting token cues makes a base model's performance competitive with that of its reinforcement learning (RL)-trained counterparts on math and coding. For instance, the cue ".\n\nOkay" raises Olmo-3-7B's MATH-500 pass@1 accuracy from 42% to 78%, while "Alright," raises Qwen3-14B's from 72% to 87%. Second, RL makes these cues more likely, wh…
items.why_zh: 仅靠起始 token 提示就能大幅改变成绩，说明推理评测易受表面线索影响，也凸显训练数据模式对能力表现的关键作用。
items.why_en: A single starting-token cue can swing benchmark scores dramatically, warning that reasoning evaluations are sensitive to surface cues and that data patterns shape apparent capability.

items.title_zh: GAIATrace：首个 token 级智能体轨迹数据集，刻画复杂 AI 智能体的通用任务表现
items.title_en: Characterizing How Complex Agentic AI Systems Handle General Tasks: A Trace-Based Simulation Study
items.summary_zh: 智能体式 AI 通过迭代规划、工具调用和基于结果的推理来完成任务，但其系统级行为仍缺乏清晰理解，尤其在复杂数据集与智能体架构下——原因包括执行高度不确定、评测成本高昂，以及对专有模型的可观测性有限。本文提出 GAIATrace，这是首个针对两个先进智能体系统（MiroThinker 与 OWL）在 GAIA 这一异构基准上运行的 token 级轨迹数据集。基于轨迹的模拟分析有助于刻画复杂智能体系统处理通用任务的方式。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.01725v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Agentic AI completes tasks through iterative planning, tool use, and reasoning based on observed outcomes. Despite its popularity, its system-level behavior remains poorly understood, particularly for complex datasets and agent architectures-owing to highly non-deterministic execution, prohibitive evaluation costs, and limited visibility into proprietary models. This paper presents GAIATrace, the first token-level trace dataset of two state-of-the-art agentic systems (MiroThinker and OWL) running GAIA, a benchmark composed of a heterogeneous…
items.why_zh: 首个 token 级智能体轨迹数据集，为理解和诊断复杂 AI 智能体的系统级行为提供了可复用的观测基础。
items.why_en: As the first token-level trace dataset for agentic systems, it provides a reusable observational basis for understanding and diagnosing their system-level behavior.

items.title_zh: 先看后动：动态3D故事世界中的叙事锚定视觉注意力
items.title_en: Look-Before-Move: Narrative-Grounded World Visual Attention in Dynamic 3D Story Worlds
items.summary_zh: 该论文关注动态3D环境中的视觉感知问题：随着具身AI与世界模型越来越多地运行于这类环境，感知不应只停留在被动解读已有观察，而应主动决定要看什么。作者以动态3D故事世界中的相机规划为研究对象，要求相机不仅生成平滑的运动轨迹，还要在移动之前判断应先获取哪些视觉证据。论文将这一能力定义为“叙事锚定的世界视觉注意力”（Narrative-Grounded World Visual Attention），其中相机被视作一个具身观察者。这为从被动感知走向主动感知提供了新的问题设定。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.26964v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: As embodied AI and world models increasingly operate in dynamic 3D environments, visual perception must move beyond passively interpreting given observations toward actively deciding what to observe. We study this problem through camera planning in dynamic 3D story worlds, where the camera must not only generate smooth motion, but also decide what visual evidence should be acquired before it moves. We formulate this capability as Narrative-Grounded World Visual Attention, where the camera acts as an embodied observer that determines what to o…
items.why_zh: 把感知系统从被动解读观察推进到主动决定“看什么”，为具身AI与世界模型的主动感知提供了新的问题定义。
items.why_en: It reframes perception as actively deciding what to observe, offering a new problem formulation for active perception in embodied AI and world models.

items.title_zh: 螺旋几何遇上多臂老虎机：增量获取示教以生成操作规划
items.title_en: Screw Geometry Meets Bandits: Incremental Acquisition of Demonstrations to Generate Manipulation Plans
items.summary_zh: 论文研究如何一次一条地、有方法地获取“足够”的动觉示教，使机器人对自身能在工作空间的特定区域内完成复杂操作任务具有信心。尽管“示教编程”一直是活跃的研究领域，但判断一组示教是否充分、以及系统性地寻求更多示教这两个问题仍悬而未决。作者提出一种让机器人主动、增量地请求示教的方法，从标题看其思路结合了螺旋几何（screw geometry）与多臂老虎机（bandits）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2410.18275v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this paper, we study the problem of methodically obtaining a sufficient set of kinesthetic demonstrations, one at a time, such that a robot can be confident of its ability to perform a complex manipulation task in a given region of its workspace. Although programming by demonstration has been an active area of research, the problems of checking whether a set of demonstrations is sufficient and systematically seeking additional demonstrations have remained open. We present an approach for the robot to incrementally and actively ask fo…
items.why_zh: 把“示教是否足够、还缺哪一条”变成可判断、可主动求解的问题，提升示教编程的可靠性与效率。
items.why_en: It turns the question of whether demonstrations suffice—and which one is still missing—into something a robot can judge and actively resolve, improving the reliability of programming by demonstration.

items.title_zh: 自监督强化学习的1000层网络：加深网络解锁新的目标到达能力
items.title_en: 1000 Layer Networks for Self-Supervised RL: Scaling Depth Can Enable New Goal-Reaching Capabilities
items.summary_zh: 在语言与视觉领域，自监督学习的规模化带来了突破，而强化学习（RL）尚未出现可比的进展。该论文研究能够显著提升自监督RL可扩展性的基础构件，发现网络深度是关键因素。近年来多数RL论文依赖约2–5层的浅层架构，而作者证明将深度提升到最多1024层可以显著提高性能；实验还表明，加深网络能够解锁新的目标到达（goal-reaching）能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2503.14858v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Scaling up self-supervised learning has driven breakthroughs in language and vision, yet comparable progress has remained elusive in reinforcement learning (RL). In this paper, we study building blocks for self-supervised RL that unlock substantial improvements in scalability, with network depth serving as a critical factor. Whereas most RL papers in recent years have relied on shallow architectures (around 2 - 5 layers), we demonstrate that increasing the depth up to 1024 layers can significantly boost performance. Our experiments are…
items.why_zh: 提示“深度”这一长期被忽视的维度可能是自监督RL规模化的关键，为RL的扩展提供了新方向。
items.why_en: It suggests that depth, a largely overlooked dimension, may be key to scaling self-supervised RL, opening a new direction for RL research.

items.title_zh: Oolong：评测长上下文推理与聚合能力
items.title_en: Oolong: Evaluating Long Context Reasoning and Aggregation Capabilities
items.summary_zh: 随着模型上下文长度不断增长，人们持续担心模型是否真正有效利用了完整的上下文。近期虽已发布若干精心设计的长上下文评测，但它们往往依赖从上下文的一个或多个片段中检索信息，这使得几乎大部分上下文token都可以被当作噪声忽略。作者指出，这只是长上下文任务的一种类型，并提出 Oolong——一组需要分析并聚合整个上下文的长上下文推理任务基准，用以更全面地考察模型的推理与聚合能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2511.02817v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: As model context lengths continue to grow, concerns about whether models effectively use the full context length have persisted. While several carefully designed long-context evaluations have recently been released, these evaluations tend to rely on retrieval from one or more sections of the context, which allows nearly all of the context tokens to be disregarded as noise. This represents only one type of task that might be performed with long context. We introduce Oolong, a benchmark of long-context reasoning tasks that require analyzi…
items.why_zh: 现有长上下文评测偏重“大海捞针”式检索，Oolong 用需要真正通读并聚合全上下文的任务，更严格地检验模型的长上下文能力。
items.why_en: Existing long-context tests lean on needle-in-a-haystack retrieval; Oolong demands genuine reasoning and aggregation over the entire context, giving a stricter measure of long-context ability.

items.title_zh: 莱比锡基准：49位数学家编成的研究级数学题库
items.title_en: Benchmarks in Leipzig
items.summary_zh: 在2026年4月1日至5月15日期间，一组49位数学家编制了一份带有已知答案的研究级数学问题数据集，其中大部分工作在德国莱比锡马克斯·普朗克数学科学研究所举办的、为期三天并有35位参与者参加的“Benchmarks in Leipzig”工作坊中完成。作者发布了最终收录的100道题目，并分三阶段进行评估：先由五个最先进的大语言模型及其前代模型各尝试一次，随后进行每个模型运行20次的评测。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.05818v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Between April 1 and May 15, 2026, a group of 49 mathematicians compiled a dataset of research-level mathematics questions with known answers. Most of the work was done during the three-day workshop Benchmarks in Leipzig with 35 participants at the Max Planck Institute for Mathematics in the Sciences in Leipzig, Germany. We present the resulting collection of 100~questions. We evaluated these questions in three stages: a single attempt by five state-of-the-art LLMs and their predecessors, followed by a 20-runs-per-model evaluation with t…
items.why_zh: 提供了一批由专家编写、答案已知的研究级数学题，用于检验前沿大语言模型在真正研究难度上的表现。
items.why_en: It offers expert-authored, answer-verified research-level math problems for probing how frontier LLMs perform at genuine research difficulty.

items.title_zh: 联邦MLLM微调的持续学习：弹性正则化与合成回放
items.title_en: Continual Learning with Elastic Regularization and Synthetic Replay for Federated MLLM Fine-Tuning
items.summary_zh: 在分布式网络中对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）进行联邦微调，可以在保护隐私的前提下适应不断变化的数据流，但一个根本障碍阻碍了其在动态环境中的稳健部署：灾难性遗忘，即顺序进行的任务更新会抹去此前在视觉、语言与跨模态表示中获得的知识。作者针对这一挑战提出结合弹性正则化（elastic regularization）与合成回放（synthetic replay）的持续学习方法，并指出该问题在内容审核等安全敏感领域的自主联网AI中尤为关键。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.12112v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Federated fine-tuning of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) across distributed networks enables privacy-sensitive adaptation to evolving data streams, yet a fundamental obstacle prevents robust deployment in dynamic environments: catastrophic forgetting, wherein sequential task updates erase previously acquired knowledge across visual, linguistic, and cross-modal representations. Addressing this challenge is especially critical for autonomous networked AI operating in safety-sensitive domains, such as content moderation, where rel…
items.why_zh: 缓解联邦微调中的灾难性遗忘，是MLLM在隐私敏感且持续变化的真实场景中可部署的前提。
items.why_en: Mitigating catastrophic forgetting in federated fine-tuning is a prerequisite for deploying MLLMs in privacy-sensitive, continuously changing real-world settings.

items.title_zh: 语言模型时代的AI问责生态
items.title_en: The AI Accountability Ecosystem in the Era of Language Models
items.summary_zh: 文章基于“问责生态”（accountability ecosystems）回顾并更新了AI问责框架，纳入自大语言模型面向公众发布以来的最新进展。作者提出三项相互关联的更新：(i) 将问责生态重新定向到AI基础设施与供应链；(ii) 更强调结果监测，以及识别有助于去中心化系统改进的问题；(iii) 摘要此处截断，其余更新未在可见内容中说明。整体上，文章主张在LLM时代从单一模型问责转向对基础设施、供应链与实际结果的持续监测。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12320v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This article reviews and updates the framework for accountability in AI based on account- ability ecosystems. We update the framework in light of the latest developments since the release of Large Language Models for general public use. We propose three interlinked updates to the original AI accountability ecosystem: (i) reorienting the accountability ecosystem to AI infrastructure and supply chains, (ii) providing greater emphasis on outcomes monitoring and identification of issues that support decentralized system improvement, and (ii…
items.why_zh: 随着LLM广泛部署，问责重心需要从单个模型转向基础设施、供应链与结果监测，以支撑系统性改进。
items.why_en: As LLMs become widely deployed, accountability must shift from individual models toward infrastructure, supply chains and outcomes monitoring to enable systemic improvement.

items.title_zh: 微调会抹掉激活引导吗？行为恢复但权重编辑未被逆转
items.title_en: Does Fine-Tuning Undo Activation Steering? Behavioural Recovery Without Weight-Edit Reversal
items.summary_zh: 激活引导可以直接嵌入语言模型的权重之中，从而在不做推理时干预的情况下塑造行为，为在模型发布前编码对齐提供了一条途径。然而模型在部署后经常会被继续微调，这种嵌入式干预能否幸存此前并不清楚。作者在五个指令微调模型（3B–14B）上，研究用于“拒绝消融”和“简洁性增强”的嵌入式引导，在非对抗性SFT与RLHF下的稳定性，发现优化越强引导退化越厉害，并出现行为层面的恢复，而权重编辑本身并未被逆转。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.24988v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Activation steering can be embedded directly into a language model's weights, shaping behaviour without inference-time intervention and offering a way to encode alignment prior to release. However, models are routinely fine-tuned after deployment, and it is unknown whether embedded interventions survive this. We study the stability of embedded steering for refusal ablation and brevity amplification across five instruction-tuned models (3B-14B) under non-adversarial SFT and RLHF. We find that steering degrades more under stronger optimis…
items.why_zh: 说明权重中嵌入的对齐干预并非一劳永逸：部署后微调会削弱其效果，行为看似恢复时机制层面未必真的被撤销。
items.why_en: Embedded alignment interventions are not permanent: post-deployment fine-tuning erodes them, and behavior can recover even when the underlying weight edits have not been reversed.

items.title_zh: 概念与组块的统一解释
items.title_en: A Unified Account of Concepts and Chunks
items.summary_zh: 认知心理学一方面研究人如何编码、使用和学习描述类别的概念，另一方面研究人如何表征、识别和习得熟悉元素模式的“组块”，但这两条文献脉络几乎互不相交，给统一认知理论带来了挑战。本文先回顾 Cobweb——一个关于分类与概念形成的计算模型，然后提出一个扩展理论，把组块及其习得也纳入其中。该理论不对信息模态作出承诺，因而可适用于不同形式的信息。作者希望借此为概念与组块的统一解释铺路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30414v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Cognitive psychology has studied how people encode, use, and learn concepts that describe categories, and how they represent, recognize, and acquire chunks for familiar patterns of elements. The literatures on these two topics are nearly disjoint, which poses a challenge for unified theories of cognition. In this paper, we review Cobweb, a computational account of categorization and concept formation, then propose an extended theory that incorporates chunks and their acquisition. The theory makes no commitments about modality, applying…
items.why_zh: 它试图弥合长期割裂的概念研究与组块研究，为统一认知理论提供可计算框架。
items.why_en: It attempts to bridge two long-separated research strands, offering a computational route toward a unified theory of cognition.

items.title_zh: 优化器几何决定节奏：矩阵分解中的谱学习动态
items.title_en: Optimizer Geometry Sets the Pace: Spectral Learning Dynamics in Matrix Factorization
items.summary_zh: 矩阵与曲率类优化器近来的成功，让人们重新关注更新的几何结构如何塑造学习过程：这类方法对更新做归一化或预条件处理，从而改变训练中不同成分的推进速度。在深度矩阵分解中，拖慢梯度下降的几何结构会因为推迟小奇异模式的出现而偏向低秩解。本文研究当归一化或曲率校正削弱乃至消除这种减速时，上述谱偏置还剩下什么，由此刻画优化器几何对学习节奏的决定作用。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.04249v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent successes of matrix- and curvature-based optimizers have renewed interest in how update geometry shapes learning. These methods normalize or precondition updates, changing how different components progress during training. In deep matrix factorization, the geometry that slows gradient descent (GD) favors low-rank solutions by delaying the emergence of small singular modes. This raises the question of what remains of that spectral bias when normalization or curvature correction weakens or removes the slowdown. We study how optimizer geometr…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了优化器的几何选择如何直接决定学习过程中的谱偏置与收敛节奏。
items.why_en: It clarifies how the geometry of an optimizer directly shapes spectral bias and the pace of learning.

items.title_zh: 潜意识学习中的跨特质迁移
items.title_en: Cross-Trait Transfer in Subliminal Learning
items.summary_zh: “潜意识学习”指学生语言模型仅在语义无关的输出上训练，却能习得教师模型的行为特质；这是一种微妙的统计现象，因为特质传递依赖生成数据中的弱统计模式。为理解师生配对之间的特质传递，作者研究了“跨特质迁移”，即教师某一特质下生成的数据如何改变学生对其他特质的偏好。为此，他们引入一个有向的特质迁移矩阵来量化这些效应。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.04260v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Subliminal learning is a phenomenon where a student language model acquires a teacher model's behavioral traits by training on semantically unrelated outputs. It is a subtle statistical phenomenon as trait transmission relies on weak statistical patterns in the generated data. To understand trait transmission between teacher-student pairs, we study cross-trait transfer: how data generated under one teacher trait changes the student's preferences of other traits. To this end, we introduce a directed trait-transfer matrix that quantifies these effe…
items.why_zh: 它把隐性的特质传递从现象观察推进到可量化的迁移结构分析，关乎模型行为与安全。
items.why_en: It moves trait transmission from anecdote to a quantifiable transfer structure, with implications for model behavior and safety.

items.title_zh: 面向未经策划短视频的十亿级缩略图多臂老虎机优化
items.title_en: Billion-Scale Thumbnail Optimization for Uncurated Short-Form Videos via Multi-Armed Bandits
items.summary_zh: 论文介绍了一套部署在大型短视频平台、覆盖全球十亿量级（O(B)）的实时缩略图优化系统。与创作者精心挑选自定义封面的长视频不同，相当一部分短视频发布时并没有人工选择的画面。针对这类未经人工策划的内容，作者提出端到端的全自动框架，用数据驱动的动态选择取代静态默认帧，覆盖数十亿视频。据作者所知，这是首个此类系统（摘要在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.04931v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper introduces a real-time thumbnail optimization system deployed at a global $O(B)$ scale on a major short-form video platform. Unlike traditional long-form content, where custom thumbnails are heavily curated by creators, a considerable fraction of short-form videos are published without human-selected artwork. To address this uncurated corpus, we present a fully automated, end-to-end framework that replaces static default frames with dynamic, data-driven selections across billions of videos. To the best of our knowledge, this is the fir…
items.why_zh: 它把多臂老虎机用于超大规模工业场景，填补了无人工封面短视频的自动化优化空白。
items.why_en: It applies multi-armed bandits at industrial scale to automate thumbnail selection for videos that have no curated artwork.

items.title_zh: ColdDDI：评估冷启动药物相互作用预测中的知识利用
items.title_en: ColdDDI: Evaluating Knowledge Utilization in Cold-Start Drug-Drug Interaction Prediction
items.summary_zh: 冷启动药物-药物相互作用（DDI）预测考察模型能否为训练阶段没有相互作用记录的药物识别出临床显著的相互作用。现有基准大多只报告聚合的边预测分数，留下一个关键评估问题：当模型获得分子、文本或知识图谱（KG）证据时，它们是否真的用上了药理学上支持该相互作用的证据？为此作者提出 ColdDDI，一个基于 DrugBank 5.1.13 构建、可重建的诊断性基准，涵盖 1,900 个已批准条目（摘要在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.05590v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cold-start drug-drug interaction (DDI) prediction tests whether models can identify clinically significant interactions for drugs without training-time interaction history. Existing benchmarks mostly report aggregate edge-prediction scores, leaving a key evaluation question unanswered: when models receive molecular, textual, or knowledge-graph (KG) evidence, do they actually use the evidence that pharmacologically supports the interaction? We introduce ColdDDI, a reconstructible diagnostic benchmark built from DrugBank 5.1.13, with 1,900 approved…
items.why_zh: 它把评测重点从分数转向“模型是否真的用了药理证据”，让冷启动 DDI 评估更具诊断性。
items.why_en: It shifts DDI evaluation from aggregate scores to whether models genuinely use supporting pharmacological evidence.

items.title_zh: 超越分布内保持：用面向脆弱性的微调恢复量化 VLA 的泛化能力
items.title_en: Beyond In-Distribution Preservation: Recovering Generalization in Quantized VLAs via Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning
items.summary_zh: 训练后量化已被证明能在标准评测条件下保持 VLA（视觉-语言-动作模型）的原有性能，但它是否保住了全精度模型的鲁棒性与泛化能力，仍缺乏充分研究。作者系统考察了量化后 VLA 策略在环境扰动下的鲁棒性与泛化表现，结果显示：量化策略虽然分布内性能相当，却可能对细微的环境变化变得脆弱。研究还观察到动作差异（摘要在此处截断），并据此提出面向脆弱性的微调思路来恢复泛化。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.05745v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Post-training quantization has been shown to preserve VLA performance under standard evaluation conditions, but whether it preserves the full-precision model's robustness and generalization remains underexplored. In this study, we systematically study the robustness and generalization of post-quantized VLA policies under environmental disturbances. Empirical results show that quantized policies can become fragile to subtle environmental variations despite retaining comparable in-distribution performance. We further observe that action discrepanci…
items.why_zh: 它提醒量化压缩可能悄悄牺牲机器人策略在真实扰动下的可靠性，并给出针对性修复方案。
items.why_en: It warns that quantization can silently undermine a policy's robustness to real-world disturbances, and offers a targeted fix.

items.title_zh: 上下文相关服务速率下的边调度边学习：一种随时率最优算法
items.title_en: Learning While Scheduling Jobs under Context-Dependent Service Rates: An Anytime Rate-Optimal Algorithm
items.summary_zh: 论文研究上下文队列老虎机问题：学习者一边调度作业，一边学习未知的服务速率，后者被建模为作业与服务器特征的逻辑函数。性能以队列长度遗憾衡量，即第 t 轮相对于已知服务速率的“神谕”而言的期望超额队列长度。现有递减遗憾保证要么衰减率次优，要么需要预先知道固定时间范围，并且假设逐上下文的松弛条件和特征协方差的严格正最小特征值。针对这些限制，作者提出 WISE 算法（摘要在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06006v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study contextual queueing bandits, where a learner schedules jobs while learning unknown service rates modeled by logistic functions of job-server features. Performance is measured by queue length regret, the expected excess queue length at round $t$ relative to an oracle that knows the service rates. Existing decaying-regret guarantees either have a suboptimal decay rate or require a known fixed horizon. They also assume context-wise slack and a strictly positive minimum eigenvalue of the feature covariance. In this paper, we propose WISE (Wi…
items.why_zh: 它以队列长度而非仅累积遗憾为目标，为实际调度场景提供了更贴合需求的率最优学习算法。
items.why_en: By targeting queue length rather than only cumulative regret, it offers rate-optimal learning better suited to real scheduling systems.

items.title_zh: 基于世界模型与检索式行动规划的超声操作引导
items.title_en: Ultrasound Operator Guidance Using World Modeling and Retrieval Based Action Planning
items.summary_zh: 超声检查应用广泛，但成像质量高度依赖操作者的知识与经验；随着检查需求增长快于受训超声技师的供给，操作引导系统希望教会经验较少的用户如何把探头移向目标视图。本文提出一种检索诱导的潜转移模型来刻画超声采集动态，将超声操作引导表述为世界模型中的多步规划与检索问题。方法以 V-JEPA 2.1 作为骨干网络（摘要在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06008v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultrasound is widely used, but acquisition quality is heavily dependent on the operator's knowledge and expertise. With demand for examinations outpacing the supply of trained sonographers, operator-guidance systems aim to close this gap by instructing a less trained user how to move the probe toward a target view. In this paper, we propose a retrieval-induced latent transition model for ultrasound acquisition dynamics, formulating ultrasound operator guidance as multi-step planning and retrieval in a world model. Using a V-JEPA 2.1 backbone, obs…
items.why_zh: 它把世界模型与检索式规划用于医疗操作引导，有望缓解超声技师短缺带来的检查瓶颈。
items.why_en: It applies world-model planning to medical guidance, potentially easing the sonographer shortage bottleneck.

items.title_zh: 面向鲁棒大模型后训练的动态最小最大遗憾优化
items.title_en: Dynamic Minimax Regret Optimization for Robust LLM Post-Training
items.summary_zh: 现代大模型训练越来越依赖跨领域、跨任务、跨偏好分布和不同难度等级的异构数据源，如何在训练中动态选择数据成为关键问题。论文研究在仅有即时小批量 bandit 反馈条件下的“组分布鲁棒”LLM 后训练，提出动态最小最大遗憾（dynamic minimax regret）框架。该框架把训练建模为采样器与优化器的双人过程：采样器基于 bandit 反馈自适应地在各数据源间选择，优化器则利用被选中数据源的随机梯度更新模型参数。这一设定为异构数据下提升后训练的鲁棒性提供了理论化的优化视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06329v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern LLM training increasingly relies on heterogeneous data sources spanning different domains, tasks, preference distributions, and difficulty levels. We study dynamic minimax regret for group-distributionally robust LLM post-training under instantaneous mini-batch-only bandit feedback. The framework views the training as a two-player sampler-optimizer process: a sampler adaptively selects among data sources using bandit feedback, while an optimizer updates the model parameters using stochastic gradients from the selected source. We focus on t…
items.why_zh: 为异构数据源下的 LLM 后训练提供了一个可分析、可优化的鲁棒决策框架。
items.why_en: It provides an analyzable, optimizable robust framework for data-source selection in LLM post-training.

items.title_zh: EMG-FM-Bench：肌电信号基础模型迁移与适配的综合基准
items.title_en: EMG-FM-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Foundation Model Transfer and Adaptation on Electromyography
items.summary_zh: 基础模型正被越来越多地用于通用时间序列和生理信号，但它们能否迁移到下游生理任务仍缺乏系统认识。肌电（EMG）尤为棘手：信号分布会因使用者、传感配置、采集硬件和下游任务的不同而显著变化。为此，作者提出 EMG-FM-Bench，一个系统评估基础模型在 EMG 上迁移与适配能力的基准，统一整合了 20 个公开数据集。该基准旨在为这一领域提供可比较、可复现的评测基础。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06450v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation models (FMs) are increasingly being developed for general time series and physiological signals, yet their transferability to downstream physiological tasks remains poorly understood. This question is particularly challenging for electromyography (EMG), where signal distributions vary substantially across users, sensing configurations, acquisition hardware, and downstream tasks. We introduce EMG-FM-Bench, a systematic benchmark for studying foundation-model transfer and adaptation on EMG. EMG-FM-Bench unifies 20 public datasets with ov…
items.why_zh: 为长期碎片化、难以比较的肌电基础模型评测建立了统一基准。
items.why_en: It establishes a unified benchmark for a fragmented and hard-to-compare EMG foundation-model landscape.

items.title_zh: 基于反事实追踪的在线控制
items.title_en: Online Control via Counterfactual Tracking
items.summary_zh: 论文研究已知线性动态系统的在线控制问题，其中代价由对手设定、扰动有界，并以一类通用基准策略作为遗憾比较对象。作者提出“反事实追踪”（counterfactual tracking）方法，把“学习”与“控制”两个难点分离：在线学习器根据实际发生的代价与扰动，构造出基准策略本会产生的轨迹并加以选择或平均，形成参考轨迹；随后由一个校正控制律将系统引导向该参考轨迹。该思路为对抗环境下的在线控制提供了新的分析框架。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.13029v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study online control of a known linear dynamical system with adversarial costs and bounded disturbances, measuring regret against a general class of benchmark policies. We introduce counterfactual tracking, which separates the challenge of learning from the challenge of controlling the system. An online learner builds a reference trajectory by selecting or averaging the trajectories that the benchmark policies would have generated under the realized costs and disturbances, and a corrective law steers the system toward that reference. Chargin…
items.why_zh: 通过分离学习与控制，为对抗性扰动下的在线控制提供了一种新的方法论。
items.why_en: Separating learning from control offers a new methodology for online control under adversarial disturbances.

items.title_zh: 拆分语言模型中的文本泄露：梯度究竟增加了多少信息
items.title_en: What Gradients Add to Text Leakage in Split Language Models, Counted per Token and per Document
items.summary_zh: 拆分学习允许客户端在不把文本发送给服务器的前提下训练语言模型：客户端自行运行前几层，只把每个 token 对应的向量输出发给服务器，训练时服务器再回传梯度。作者证明，站在“拆分点”的观察者可以从这些通信数据中重建出客户端的大部分文本，并量化了梯度带来的额外泄露。在 GPT-2 上，仅掌握客户端层公开权重的攻击者，单凭激活值即可恢复 94.20% 的 token，若再结合梯度则可达 97.38%。这说明拆分学习并不足以保护训练文本隐私。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.04128v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Split learning lets a client train a language model on a server without sending its text. The client runs the first layers itself and sends the server only their output, a vector of numbers for each token. During training, the server sends gradients back. We show that an observer at the split can rebuild most of the client's text from this traffic, and we measure how much the gradients help. On GPT-2, an attacker who holds only the publicly released weights of the client's layers recovers 94.20% of tokens from the activations alone and 97.38% w…
items.why_zh: 以量化证据表明拆分学习会严重泄露训练文本，动摇了其隐私保护的默认假设。
items.why_en: It quantifies severe text leakage in split learning, challenging its assumed privacy guarantees.

items.title_zh: PROTECT-90 数据集上的单周期故障分类与故障线路辨识基准
items.title_en: One-Cycle Fault Classification and Faulted-Line Identification on the PROTECT-90 Dataset: An Initial Application Benchmark
items.summary_zh: 开放电磁暂态数据集的出现，使基于学习的继电保护研究开始具备可复现性，但要真正落地，还需要定义时序、传感与验证假设的应用级基准。本文在最新发布的 PROTECT-90 数据集上，针对故障类型分类和离散故障线路辨识两项保护任务，提出了一个初步的应用基准。作者评估了一个紧凑的一维卷积神经网络（CNN），并采用故障发生后起始阶段的数据进行实验。该工作为电力系统保护中的学习类方法提供了可参照的评测起点。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.04155v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Open electromagnetic-transient datasets are beginning to make reproducible learning-based protection studies possible, but the practical use of these datasets still requires application-level benchmarks that define timing, sensing, and validation assumptions. This paper presents an initial application benchmark on the recently released PROTECT-90 dataset for two protection-oriented tasks: fault-type classification and discrete faulted-line identification. A compact one-dimensional convolutional neural network (CNN) is evaluated using post-incep…
items.why_zh: 为学习型继电保护研究补上了时序与验证假设明确的应用级评测基准。
items.why_en: It supplies an application-level benchmark with explicit timing and validation assumptions for learning-based protection research.

items.title_zh: WASP：面向胎儿脑部 MRI-超声学习的弱对齐时空配对
items.title_en: WASP: Weakly Aligned Spatiotemporal Pairs for Fetal Brain MRI-Ultrasound Learning
items.summary_zh: 磁共振成像（MRI）因软组织对比度和解剖细节出色，被普遍视为胎儿脑部分析的最佳模态，但其成本高、操作负担重，难以大规模获取。相比之下，超声（US）便宜、安全且常规采集，因此积累了远为庞大的数据集和日益丰富的预训练模型生态。这种不对称引出一个自然问题：能否仅用少量 MRI 数据，教会一个纯超声模型理解胎儿 MRI？作者提出 WASP，通过弱对齐的时空配对来实现这一跨模态知识迁移。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.04601v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is widely regarded as the optimal sensor for fetal brain analysis due to its superior soft-tissue contrast and anatomical detail. However, its high cost and operational burden make it invasive and difficult to obtain at scale. Ultrasound (US), in contrast, is cheap, safe, and routinely acquired, and as a result it has produced substantially larger datasets and a growing ecosystem of pretrained models. This asymmetry raises a natural question: Can we teach a US-only model to understand fetal MRI from only a limit…
items.why_zh: 尝试用稀缺的高质量 MRI 知识提升数据丰富的超声模型，缓解胎儿影像的模态不对称。
items.why_en: It leverages scarce high-quality MRI knowledge to improve data-rich ultrasound models, easing modality asymmetry in fetal imaging.

items.title_zh: SepRQ：基于无掩码多尺度源分离的自监督语音混合表征学习
items.title_en: SepRQ : Self-Supervised Speech Mixture Representation Learning via Mask-Free, Multi-Scale Source Separation
items.summary_zh: 自监督学习（SSL）已成为语音表征学习的主流，但主流模型面向单说话人音频设计，在多说话人场景中作用有限。作者提出 SepRQ，一个开源 SSL 框架，用基于冻结随机投影码本的“伪源分离”目标取代传统的掩码预测。其无掩码、多分辨率的做法在 SUPERB 基准的说话人日志（Speaker Diarization）与语音分离任务上取得当前最优表现，并超过了 WavLM。该工作为多说话人场景下的语音表征学习提供了新的自监督范式。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.04690v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) is standard for speech representation learning, but mainstream models are designed around single-speaker audio, limiting their usefulness in multi-speakers scenarios. We present SepRQ, an open-source SSL framework that replaces masked prediction with a pseudo-source-separation objective over frozen random-projection codebooks. By adopting a novel mask-free, multiresolution approach, SepRQ achieves state-of-the-art performance in Speaker Diarization and Speech Separation on the SUPERB benchmark, surpassing WavLM an…
items.why_zh: 以无掩码的多尺度分离目标刷新多说话人语音任务表现，拓展了语音自监督学习的适用边界。
items.why_en: Its mask-free multi-scale separation objective advances multi-speaker speech tasks, broadening the scope of speech SSL.

items.title_zh: 通过“监控任务订单化”协同无人机配送拼单与路网监测
items.title_en: Synergizing Drone Delivery Order Pooling and Road Network Monitoring through Monitoring-Task Orderization
items.summary_zh: 论文研究共享无人机机队在按需外卖配送与城市路网监测中的实时调度问题。作者考虑“骑手—无人机”协作模式：骑手把订单运至起降点，无人机完成到取货柜的最后一程配送。无人机可以在一次飞行中合并多个起点—终点订单，并在满足配送时限的前提下，做出兼顾监测的路线调整，以采集实时交通信息。这构成了一个将动态订单分配与监测任务耦合起来的联合决策问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.05270v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper investigates the real-time dispatch of a shared drone fleet for on-demand food delivery and urban road network monitoring. We consider a courier-drone collaborative setting in which couriers transport orders to launchpads and drones complete the final delivery leg to kiosks. Drones may consolidate multiple origin-destination orders within one flight and make monitoring-aware route adjustments to collect real-time traffic information subject to delivery-time constraints. This yields a joint decision problem coupling dynamic order-to-d…
items.why_zh: 展示如何让配送无人机在送餐途中顺带完成路网监测，一举两得地提升城市运力与交通感知。
items.why_en: It shows how delivery drones can also collect road-network monitoring data en route, jointly serving logistics and urban traffic sensing.

items.title_zh: SALUS：通过多智能体输出的弱监督自动审计 NL-to-SQL 基准
items.title_en: SALUS: Automated Auditing of NL-to-SQL Benchmarks through Weak Supervision of Multi-Agent Output
items.summary_zh: 自然语言转 SQL（NL-to-SQL）基准是数据分析研究进展的基础，但已有工作表明，广泛使用的基准中存在大量标注错误。这些错误会悄无声息地污染评测指标、惩罚正确的模型输出，并扭曲学界对当前最优性能的认识。为此，作者提出 SALUS 系统，可自动检测 NL-to-SQL 基准中的标注错误，其核心思路是把基准审计建模为一种弱监督错误检测：利用多个大模型生成的 SQL 输出作为信号来定位可疑标注。该工作有望提升基准评测的可靠性，让模型能力的比较更可信。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.05540v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Natural language to SQL (NL-to-SQL) benchmarks are foundational to progress in data analysis research, yet recent work has shown that widely-used benchmarks contain significant annotation errors. These errors silently corrupt evaluation metrics, penalize correct model output, and distort the field's understanding of state-of-the-art performance. We present SALUS, a system that automatically detects annotation errors in NL-to-SQL benchmarks. SALUS frames benchmark auditing as a weakly supervised error detection: SQL generated by multiple LLM age…
items.why_zh: 基准标注错误会系统性扭曲整个 NL-to-SQL 领域的性能结论，自动审计是恢复评测可信度的关键一步。
items.why_en: Annotation errors silently distort reported state-of-the-art results, so automated auditing is key to restoring trust in NL-to-SQL evaluation.

items.title_zh: 各向同性高斯过程可改善高维场景下的经典贝叶斯优化
items.title_en: Isotropic Gaussian Processes Improve Vanilla Bayesian Optimization in High Dimensions
items.summary_zh: 高维贝叶斯优化（BO）常在观测数远少于输入维度的情况下拟合高斯过程（GP）代理模型。借助维度感知的先验、初始化与采集函数优化，现代经典 BO 在该设定下表现良好，但通常仍保留自动相关性判定（ARD），即为每个输入坐标拟合一个长度尺度。该研究重新审视这一建模选择，提出 Iso-BO：在保持代理模型其余部分不变的前提下，用只含一个共享长度尺度的各向同性 GP 取代 ARD GP。这项工作为高维 BO 中代理模型的设计取舍提供了受控的实证证据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.05780v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: High-dimensional Bayesian optimization (BO) often fits Gaussian process (GP) surrogates from far fewer observations than input dimensions. Modern Vanilla BO can perform well in this regime with dimension-aware priors, initialization, and acquisition optimization, but it typically retains automatic relevance determination (ARD), fitting one lengthscale per input coordinate. We study this modeling choice and propose Iso-BO, a controlled modification that replaces the ARD GP with an isotropic GP using one shared lengthscale while keeping the surro…
items.why_zh: 它直接质疑高维贝叶斯优化中沿用已久的 ARD 默认设定，为代理模型设计提供了可复现的对照结论。
items.why_en: It challenges the long-standing ARD default in high-dimensional Bayesian optimization and offers controlled evidence on surrogate design choices.

items.title_zh: 代理并非奖励：上下文赌博机中的代理后主结果获取
items.title_en: The Surrogate Is Not the Reward: Post-Surrogate Primary-Outcome Acquisition in Contextual Bandits
items.summary_zh: 该研究考察一类上下文赌博机：在采取动作之后、学习者决定是否获取决定动作价值与遗憾的主结果之前，会先观测到一个代理信号。是否值得获取主结果，取决于两方面——决策相关性（当前结果对策略比较有多重要）与观测代理后的残余不确定性。作者提出审计代理赌博机（ASB），它在 T 轮内分配 B 次主结果获取预算，同时学习一个上下文策略。ASB 在代理观测前即设定相关规则，从而在有限预算下更高效地决定何时付出获取成本。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06610v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study contextual bandits in which a surrogate is observed after the action but before the learner decides whether to acquire the primary outcome that defines action value and regret. The value of acquiring the primary outcome depends on both decision relevance (how much the current outcome matters for comparing policies) and the residual uncertainty after observing the surrogate. The Audited Surrogate Bandit (ASB) learns a contextual policy while allocating a budget of $B$ primary-outcome acquisitions over $T$ rounds. ASB sets a pre-surrogat…
items.why_zh: 它刻画了生成式系统与交互式决策中“先用廉价代理、再决定是否取真值”的普遍预算分配难题。
items.why_en: It formalizes the common budget-allocation problem of relying on cheap surrogates before paying for the true outcome in interactive decision systems.

items.title_zh: 如何扩展高能物理机器学习模型：大规模稳健架构比较的方法指南
items.title_en: How to scale your HEP ML models: A recipe for robust architecture comparisons at scale
items.summary_zh: 语言模型等领域近来的许多进展源于扩展律——用训练投入预测模型性能，而高能物理（HEP）中也已观察到类似行为。为支持进一步研究，作者提出一套系统化流程，用于推导稳健的扩展律，并在与 HEP 任务相关的预算维度上比较不同设计选择。该流程先在玩具问题上验证完整扩展轨迹，随后应用于约 110 亿喷注的 ATLAS JetSet2 数据集上的多任务 Transformer。这为高能物理中的规模化模型比较提供了可复用方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06784v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Much of the recent progress in machine learning domains such as language models has come from scaling laws that predict performance as a function of training effort. In high-energy physics (HEP) similar behavior has now been observed. To aid further study, we present a systematic procedure to derive robust scaling laws and compare design choices on the relevant budget axes for HEP tasks. items.why_zh: 它为高能物理机器学习提供了可复用的扩展律方法论，使大规模架构比较更稳健、更可解释。
items.why_en: It offers a reusable methodology for deriving scaling laws and making large-scale architecture comparisons trustworthy in high-energy physics ML.

items.title_zh: 对抗性赌博机反馈下的在线保形弃答
items.title_en: Online Conformal Abstention Under Adversarial Bandit Feedback
items.summary_zh: 随着交互式生成系统在现实应用中日益普及，其产生不可靠或错误回答的倾向引发严重担忧。保形弃答通过只在系统确信时才作答来缓解这一风险，但真实部署通常只对被选中的回答提供部分用户反馈（如点赞/点踩），且往往处于非平稳或对抗性环境中，目前尚缺乏有效的学习方法。为填补这一空白，作者提出了一种新方法，用于在仅有对抗性赌博机式反馈的条件下进行在线保形弃答。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2506.14067v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: As interactive generative systems are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, their tendency to generate unreliable or false responses raises serious concerns. Conformal abstention mitigates this risk by ensuring that the system answers only when confident. However, real-world deployments typically provide only partial user feedback (e.g., thumbs up/down) on the selected response and often operate in non-stationary or adversarial environments, for which effective learning methods are largely missing. To bridge this gap, we propose E…
items.why_zh: 它把保形弃答从理想化的完整反馈假设推进到更贴近现实的对抗性部分反馈场景。
items.why_en: It moves conformal abstention beyond idealized full-feedback assumptions toward realistic adversarial, partial-feedback deployments.

items.title_zh: Lethe：联邦遗忘中实现持久知识擦除的双流更新方法
items.title_en: Lethe: Principled Dual-Stream Update for Persistent Knowledge Erasure in Federated Unlearning
items.summary_zh: 联邦遗忘（FU）旨在从全局模型中抹除特定知识，但现有研究通常假设遗忘完成即终止联邦协作，忽略了删除请求被满足后仍会在剩余客户端上继续训练的部署场景。本文指出一个关键失效模式——知识复现：仅凭保留数据继续训练，就能在少数几轮内重新激活已被遗忘的知识。作者在实验中表明，许多先进的联邦遗忘方法都难以抵御这一现象，并提出 Lethe，一种原则性的双流更新机制，以实现持久的知识擦除。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2601.22601v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Federated unlearning (FU) aims to erase knowledge from a global model. Existing studies commonly assume that federated collaboration terminates after unlearning, overlooking a deployment-realistic scenario where training continues on the remaining clients after deletion requests are fulfilled. In this work, we identify a critical failure mode, termed knowledge resurfacing, revealing that continued training on retained data alone can reactivate unlearned knowledge in a few rounds. Empirically, we demonstrate that many state-of-the-art FU metho…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了联邦遗忘后“知识复现”这一被忽视的风险，并给出面向持续训练场景的持久擦除方案。
items.why_en: It exposes the overlooked risk that unlearned knowledge resurfaces under continued federated training, and offers a persistent-erasure remedy.

items.title_zh: TempusBench：面向时间序列预测的评测框架
items.title_en: TempusBench: An Evaluation Framework for Time-Series Forecasting
items.summary_zh: 基础模型已重塑自然语言处理与计算机视觉，而时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的研究正试图在预测任务上复制这一成功。尽管近期开源模型展现出 TSFM 的潜力，该领域仍缺乏一套全面且被社区普遍接受的模型评测框架。作者指出至少四个阻碍此类框架建立的主要问题，其中首要问题是现有评测框架所用的基准预测任务往往取自过时的数据或设定。TempusBench 由此提出，旨在为时间序列预测提供更系统、更可信的评测基准。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.11529v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Foundation models have transformed natural language processing and computer vision, and a rapidly growing literature on time-series foundation models (TSFMs) seeks to replicate this success in forecasting. While recent open-source models demonstrate the promise of TSFMs, the field lacks a comprehensive and community-accepted model evaluation framework. We see at least four major issues impeding progress on the development of such a framework. First, existing evaluation frameworks comprise benchmark forecasting tasks derived from often outdate…
items.why_zh: 缺乏公认评测框架会阻碍时间序列基础模型的可靠比较，TempusBench 试图填补这一基础设施空白。
items.why_en: Without an accepted evaluation framework, progress in time-series foundation models is hard to measure; TempusBench targets that infrastructure gap.
